name: Leh, Ladakh
description: High altitude cold desert with sub-zero winter temperatures, intense solar radiation during clear days, and extreme diurnal variation.

name: Kargil, Ladakh
description: Trans-Himalayan valley region with heavy winter snow, severe cold snaps down to -20°C, and strategic shelter requirements.

name: Drass, Ladakh
description: Second coldest inhabited place in the world. Winter temperatures drop below -30°C with severe heat loss conditions.

name: Nubra Valley, Ladakh
description: Cold desert valley surrounded by high mountains. High daytime solar potential with freezing nights.

name: Changthang Plateau, Ladakh
description: Ultra-high altitude plateau with severe gale-force winds, intense solar radiation, and extreme sub-zero conditions.
